author: AmandaAskell
text:
Seconding this, I think it only makes sense to claim someone else has "the burden of proof" if:
- they're trying to convince you a thing is true
- you're not trying to convince them the thing is false, and
- they demand you provide evidence that the thing is false

quoted.text: I endorse a subjective version of this. Burden of proof is on you if you want me to change my mind. It’s on me if I want you to change your mind. There is no agent-or-context neutral “Burden of Proof”
